title: skillprism.yaml
description: Project-level configuration file for skillprism (skillprism.yaml). Determines which harnesses to build for and where skills live. Matches ProjectConfig in src/types/project.rs. Unknown fields are rejected. harnesses defaults to an empty list when omitted.

harnesses.description: Harness IDs this project targets (e.g., claude, codex, opencode, factory, pi). Omission defaults to an empty list. The loader does not require at least one entry.

skills_dir.description: Directory containing skill definitions, relative to project root (default: skills)
